msg: The gnomes will be presented to you in set pairs. The pairs will always be the same but the positions and hat sizes may vary, this does not matter and is only a cosmetic feature.The method I used was to find the gnome which takes you to the darker forest that has the yellow basket. The gnomes that take you there are the yellow, brown, purple and pink. The score you receive will still have an random element to it but I stuck with this method and scored quite well.
